sloka: कच्चिदक्षौहिणीं भीमां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः ।ध्वजिनीं मन्त्रिभिर्गुप्तां प्रेषयिष्यति मत्कृते ।। ५.३६.२४।।।।
transliteration: kaccidakṣauhiṇīṁ bhīmāṁ bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ ।dhvajinīṁ mantribhirguptāṁ preṣayiṣyati matkṛte ।। 5.36.24।।।।

translations.english: "Will Bharata, the devoted brother, send his formidable army of one akshavhini protected by ministers for my cause? I trust he will. (Akshauhini 109350 foot soldiers 65610 horse soldiers 21860 elephants soldiers on chariot)
